messages:
Mia Chen: quick check — I noticed the 'Guides > Runtime' breadcrumb on staging resolves to 404 when navigated from the KB. Repro steps: 1) open https://staging.redwood.ai/docs/kb/routing 2) click the top breadcrumb 'Guides' 3) lands on 404. Screenshot attached in thread.

Alex Rivera: I can take this. Assigning to me for initial triage. Is this happening only in staging or did someone see prod too? :eyes:

Sam O'Neill: saw the same in prod yesterday around 09:12 PT. Seems like a redirect/frontmatter rename after the last docs deploy. Tagging Kevin since he touched the guides sidebar earlier.

Kevin Patel: likely slug drift — quick grep shows the runtime page's folder was renamed to `runtime-guide` in PR #2001. Two options: add a `permalink` frontmatter to restore `/guides/runtime` or add a tiny redirect rule. Either is a 1-file fix.

Mia Chen: go for the smallest low-risk fix. If `permalink` works, do that so SEO/canonical stays intact. Example repro header: `curl -sI https://staging.redwood.ai/guides/runtime | head` returns 404.

Alex Rivera: pinging docs-bot for a quick scan across the guides so we know if other slugs drifted.

docs-bot: Link scanner completed: found 3 pages with potential slug drift matching the `guides/*` pattern — /guides/runtime, /guides/compile, /guides/cache. Full report: https://internal/reports/linkscan/1725252525 (internal).

Kevin Patel: opened PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/2048 — adds `permalink: /guides/runtime/` to runtime frontmatter and a small redirect for trailing-slash canonicalization. PTAL @Alex @Mia

Alex Rivera: looking now, left a comment about normalizing the trailing slash in the redirect rule. Otherwise LGTM. :thumbsup:

Sam O'Neill: can we add a tiny unit/CI check to catch slug-renames that would break breadcrumbs? If quick, include it in the same PR.

Kevin Patel: added a unit test for canonical breadcrumbs and ran CI -> green. I pushed an extra commit to the PR addressing Alex's trailing-slash comment.

Mia Chen: thanks — once merged can we do a canary deploy to prod and verify the breadcrumb works end-to-end? If small, i'm fine with hotfix to prod after canary.

Alex Rivera: will coordinate the canary and ping #eng-oncall for a quick smoke test window. I'll also update the docs-owners sheet to reflect the canonical slug mapping so this doesn't happen again.

Kevin Patel: merge completed and deployed to staging. Verified with `curl -sI https://staging.redwood.ai/guides/runtime | sed -n '1,4p'` -> now 200. Will follow up with prod canary in ~15m.

Sam O'Neill: verified prod canary is green, breadcrumb fixed on prod too. :tada:

Mia Chen: great work, team. Assigning follow-up ownership to Alex to update the canonical-slugs doc and to add a tiny note in the contributor guide about not renaming slug folders without redirects.

Alex Rivera: noted — I'll post a short ping in #docs-owners after the sprint board update (card 2712). Closing thread when the board reflects the update.

Mia Chen: thanks everyone!
